rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: The fee of an appointment is the fee listed in docs/visit-fees.md for the appointment's clinician (DEC-C09), printed as '<appointment> visit fee <amount>' with two decimals in invariant culture. The command is read-only and an unknown (including cancelled) appointment is refused with the existing 'unknown appointment' error.

A clinician not listed in docs/visit-fees.md has no fee: Rules.visitFee now returns None instead of the previous unsourced 0m default, and 'fee' for such an appointment is refused with 'error: no visit fee listed for clinician <clinician>'. No source says what an unlisted clinician's fee is; this avoids printing an invented 0.00 fee but the refusal itself is not authorized and needs Finance confirmation.

'fee <appointment>' is added to Cli.usage directly after 'cancel <appointment>', which also gives 'error: usage: fee <appointment>' for wrong arity via the existing usage lookup; README command list updated to match.
